name: io.github.maehr/zenodo-uploader
title: Zenodo Uploader
description: Mirror DOIs and upload records to Zenodo, keeping the original DOI.

environmentVariables.name: ZENODO_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token for zenodo.org, with the deposit:write and deposit:actions scopes.

environmentVariables.name: ZENODO_SANDBOX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token for sandbox.zenodo.org, with the deposit:write and deposit:actions scopes.

environmentVariables.name: ZENODO_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_PUBLISH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit irreversible publishing on zenodo.org. Omit to allow drafts only.
